objective.name: sandbox.build.matter_refs
objective.description: Build concrete matter refs for later DSL @matter instantiation.

#root.role: Return local and optional remote matter refs as plain strings that a later DSL step can instantiate into @matter bindings.

transformation_contract.morphing: Simple ids become explicit matter refs reusable in later DSL @matter bindings.
invariants: local_ref is always derived from the current wrapper ctx_id plus the normalized local_matter_id.
remote_ref is returned only when a non-empty remote_matter_ref is supplied.
The capability constructs string refs only; it does not validate remote reachability or read matter content.
success: On success, sandbox.build.matter_refs returns a local_ref and optionally a remote_ref.
The returned refs are intended to be re-instantiated later into @matter bindings by DSL or wrapper logic.
failure: sandbox.build.matter_refs has no contract-level validation failure for missing params because defaults are applied locally.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This is a helper for mixed local/remote matter binding scenarios in N7.
The local_ref format is intentionally simple and wrapper-context-relative.
